synopsis: Sweden’s EVIDENT program ran from April 2022 to December 2024 and focused on simulation credibility methods [f1206]. The glossary describes this as about 33 months and names SAFER and Vinnova [f15710]. Chapter 2 cites EVIDENT alongside aviation’s ACAS X and Germany’s PEGASUS and VVM as examples where reduced physical testing rested on years of prior investment in simulation and statistical tooling [f1257]. A separate Swedish program, VaViM, ran from February to August 2022 with Volvo Autonomous Solutions and Blekinge Institute of Technology, funded through Vinnova and Drive Sweden; the supplied facts do not establish its relationship to EVIDENT [f15705, f1206].

relations.note: Both give EVIDENT’s April 2022–December 2024 timeline; glossary adds duration and organizations.
EVIDENT’s approximately 33-month duration supports the characterization of years of prior investment.
Specifies EVIDENT’s dates and simulation credibility focus within the broader precedent.
